issues.quote: It had stopped. That is all I know of it. It stopped with its master.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about the atelier regulator, its stopping, or when it stopped.
issues.misreading: A solver could take 'It stopped with its master' as a clock-based anchor for the time of death, placing the death at the moment the regulator stopped. The sheet gives no such timing, so this invites a reading of the death time that the facts do not support.
